decision.explanation: Both answers are supported by the original sources. Document d1 describes Valentine Ayika as a member of the House of Representatives of Nigeria, elected in 2015. Document d2 describes a different Valentine Ayika (notably referred to with feminine pronouns) as a current member of the Tweede Kamer, the Dutch parliament's lower house, since at least 2019. These are distinct individuals with the same name, and both positions are directly stated in the original texts.
